title: Origins: Witherious
description: A datapack that adds the Witherious Origin for the Origins (Forge) mod.
body:
# **Origins:Witherious** 

![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6b157ef41007934d8a0d69c9c7a86b9bd7afbd8.png)

> _A creature born of decay, the Witherious spreads withering essence to those that are foolish enough to cross its path._

## Powerlist   ![whiterious](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84104e691ef70e441ea288c37fa62a5a7b45f89a.png)

<details>
<summary>Wither Skin</summary>
Immune to Wither, but weakened in water and cold biomes.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Withered to the Core</summary>
Inflict Wither on a target when you hit them, but cannot eat Golden or Enchanted Apples.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Two better than One</summary>
Inflict Wither on attackers when you wear a Wither Skull.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Familiar Power</summary>
Gain strength and glowing while holding a Nether Star in your offhand.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Wither Shoot</summary>
Shoot a Wither Skull when holding one in your main hand.
</details>
